## Description

Counsel reviews clinical data handling (purposes, consent/lawful basis, retention of notes/prescriptions per country rules, patient rights) before any real clinical note is created in production.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Written sign-off before clinical features are enabled for real patients (flag remains off until then).
- [ ] **AC2.** Retention periods for notes, prescriptions and documents per country are confirmed and loaded into retention configuration.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
